decisions.name: Nawada
decisions.reason: The original UN WUP 2025 table gives Nawada two distinct City_Code rows. WUP11209 is at 24.8896035518647 N, 85.5407309971938 E, 1.52 km from the Nawada district administration’s published 24.88 N, 85.53 E location and its explicitly named headquarters town. The earlier research packet is explicitly WUP11285 and used an older normalized locator 171.1 km away, near the Madhepur/Madhubani geographic lead; the original UN 2025 point for WUP11285 is 171.61 km from WUP11209. The same name in that packet is not evidence of a prior attempt on WUP11209. Preserve the immutable WUP11209 rank, point and 290657-person population and place it into pending research. This resolves only prior-attempt identity; cadastral custody, public geometry and live adapter qualification remain unverified.

evidence.observation: Immutable WUP11209 rank 1999, India, 2025 population 290.657 thousand and point 24.8896035518647,85.5407309971938.
